findingClass: a live (UPCOMING/OPEN) IPO's stored ipos.issue_size has drifted from the issuer's current figure because the pipeline never re-checked an already-populated row after the issuer revised the size (#349, Karamtara: 1,750 Cr stored vs 875 Cr on the issuer's page, stale 4+ days)
failThreshold: abs(ipos.issue_size - Chittorgarh detail page "Total Issue Size") > Rs 1,00,000 (the smallest difference CG's 2-decimal-crore print format can express) for a live (UPCOMING/OPEN) IPO matched on chittorgarh.com's dashboard
unverifiableWhen: the chittorgarh.com dashboard cannot be fetched at all, returns zero entries for both segments, or every matched IPO's detail page is unreachable/unparseable this run
